Class Student

java.lang.Object
User
Student
public class Student extends User
Represents a student who can apply, accept and reject internships and apply for withdrawal

  • Constructor Details

    • Student

      public Student(String userID, String studentID, String name, String password, int yearOfStudy, String major, Internship internship, Application[] applications, String email)
      Constructor instantiates a Student object
      Parameters:
      userID - the unique identification number of the user in the system
      studentID - unique identification number of the Student
      name - the name of the Student
      password - the password of the Student instance
      yearOfStudy - the academic year of the Student
      major - the major that the student is studying
      internship - , the internship the student is taking, if there is none, put null
      applications - an array of Application objects. The size is up to the user and can be empty, filled or partially filled
      email - the email of the student

    • acceptInternship

      public void acceptInternship(int choice)
      allow student to accept an internship from their list of applications this clears all applications that the student has made thus removing unaccepted internships from the applications array in Student Also sets the Student internship to the corresponding application internship that they accepted
      Parameters:
      choice - the student's choice, corresponds to the index of the application in the applications array

    • rejectInternship

      public void rejectInternship(int index)
      allow student to reject an internship from their list of applications this clears the application of the corresponding internship that the student has made
      Parameters:
      index - the student's choice of what internship they want to reject corresponds to the index of the application in the applications array

    • requestWithdraw

      public void requestWithdraw(int choice)
      allow student to withdraw an application from their account Clears the particular application from the applications array
      Parameters:
      choice - the student's choice of which application to withdraw from, corresponds to the index of the application in the applications array
